items.title: Sharkey Bonano Interview, 1966-11-09
items.q: A friend of ours, Paul Crawford, remember the trombonist, he works for Tulane University too, and he interviewed Brownlee over there at Pensacola.

ctx.x: Yes, I think so. I haven't seen him in quite a while, but the last time I've seen him, he looked wonderful. I've never met him. Oh, he was a wonderful fellow.

A friend of ours, Paul Crawford, remember the trombonist, he works for Tulane University too, and he interviewed Brownlee over there at Pensacola. He did? Yeah. About four or five years ago. I guess he's still living and working there.
He was a very good salesman, a very good promoter. How was he? A pretty good pianist. Wonderful piano player.
